_about: LOPA hand-worked example 2 (spec 3.2 acceptance item 2; plan PR 7 test_example_2_matches_the_hand_worked_numbers_exactly). Written by Cowork from the reference tables and cases/demo/williams_geismar.json BEFORE the engine exists, so it is independent of the code. Every number traces to a reference row or a plant field; the arithmetic is shown. Severity is an INPUT (in a run it comes from the severity step); nothing here is a model output. This is a demo-plant fixture, not a benchmark key: it must not be used to write or tune any prompt.

reference_rows_used.causes.csv: C15 Valve left in wrong position (operator or maintenance error); applies_to includes heat_exchanger; failing_component_type operator; initiating_event_id IE-HE-MONTHLY
reference_rows_used.initiating_events.csv: IE-HE-MONTHLY Human error, task performed more than monthly but less than weekly, 0.1 per_year
reference_rows_used.protection_layers.csv: IPL-PRV: pfd 0.01; pfd_if_isolatable 0.1; no_credit_if_isolated 1; relief_kind prv

lead_finding.consequence: Heating medium admitted to EA-425B while its shell-side block valves HV-B-SIN and HV-B-SOUT are closed; shell contents heat and pressure rises above design 2068 kPa g with no open relief path; shell rupture and hydrocarbon release

scenario.r40_note: C15 is an operator cause, so its failing components must hold a step or job ID (R40/R41). P-REB-START-2 names HV-QW-B-IN and HV-QW-B-OUT, which are in EA-425B's process scope through heat_sources.
